desc: Establish that oriented rewriting \(1^Y0^X\to0^X1^Y\) is terminating and confluent, so equality of irreducible normal forms characterizes reachability.
Rigorously validate the current bulk run-boundary normalizer against exhaustive small cases and counterexamples.
Prove worst-case \(O(N)\) complexity, including repeated patterns such as \((1^Y0^X)^k\).
Confirm the implementation passes both public samples.
Validate special and edge cases including \(X=Y=2\), \(0110\) versus \(1001\), \(X=1,Y=2\), \(001\) versus \(100\), and \(X+Y>N\).
